title: The Weapon Connoisseur

{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW The Weapon Connoisseur.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Nebb]] |location= Hateno Village |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW| * Red Rupee {{Qty|2}} * Purple Rupee {{Qty|2}} * Silver Rupee {{Qty|2}} * Gold Rupee * Diamond }} |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|The Weapon Connoisseur||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|The Weapon Connoisseur}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Hateno Village}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== In [[Hateno Village]], [[Link]] can speak to Nebb, who will ask if he has traveled the world.{{Cite|Hey! Hey, mister. Did you come from the big wide world?|Nebb|BotW}} Nebb comments that Link must be strong with [[Weapon]]s and that he can probably use many different kinds.{{Cite|You look like you're good with a bow and sword, so you must be pretty strong.
Are you strong or what? I bet you can use all sorts of different weapons, right?|Nebb|BotW}} Nebb explains that his grandfather loved Weapons and wanted to see a lot of different kinds, but he died before he could see them all.{{Cite|Sooo... Do you wanna help a kid's dream come true? My gramps is dead now, but when he was alive, he loved weapons. Though he never got to see all the ones he wanted.|Nebb|BotW}} Nebb wants to continue what his grandfather started, so he asks Link to bring him Weapons from all around [[Hyrule]], thus giving him the [[Side Quest]].{{Cite|So you bring me weapons and show 'em to me, and then I can tell gramps about 'em when I meet him again!|Nebb|BotW}} Nebb asks to see the following Weapons: * The first Weapon is a [[Traveler's Sword]].{{Cite|Hmm, where should we start? Have you heard of the {{Color BotW|Blue|traveler's sword}}? I've seen it in books, but never in real life before! If you find it, please let me see it!|Nebb|BotW}}Nebb will then give Link a [[Red Rupee]] as thanks.{{Cite|{{Big|Hrm? Oh?!}} Isn't that the {{Color BotW|Blue|traveler's sword}}? Nice! Nice! Let me see, let me see!|Nebb|BotW}} * The second Weapon is a [[Fire Rod]].{{Cite|Have you heard of the {{Color BotW|Blue|fire rod}}? Grandpa said you can't find those around here. If you get ahold of one, let me see it!|Nebb|BotW}} Showing a Fire Rod to Nebb will net Link another Red Rupee.{{Cite|Isn't that the {{Color BotW|Blue|fire rod}}? So cool! Let me see!|Nebb|BotW}} * The third Weapon is a [[Moblin Club]].{{Cite|All right, the next weapon I wanna see is... What was it... Um... Oh, yes! That one! That one! Have you heard of the {{Color BotW|Blue|Moblin club}}? So...when my grandpa was young, he looked for it but couldn't find it. So please! If you find it, please let me see it!|Nebb|BotW}} He will give Link a [[Purple Rupee]] as a reward for seeing one.{{Cite|Isn't that the {{Color BotW|Blue|Moblin club}}? Nice! Nice! Let me see, let me see!|Nebb|BotW}} * The fourth Weapon is a [[Duplex Bow]].{{Cite|Have you heard of the {{Color BotW|Blue|duplex bow}}? Grandpa said you can't find those around here. If you get ahold of one, let me see it!|Nebb|BotW}} When Link brings him one, Nebb will thank him and give him another Purple Rupee.{{Cite|Isn't that the {{Color BotW|Blue|duplex bow}}? You remembered our promise! Thanks! Let me see!|Nebb|BotW}} * The fifth Weapon is a [[Windcleaver]].{{Cite|Have you heard of the {{Color BotW|Blue|windcleaver}}? Grandpa said you can't find those around here. If you get ahold of one, let me see it!|Nebb|BotW}} If Link brings Nebb a Windcleaver, he will reward him with a [[Silver Rupee]].{{Cite|Isn't that the {{Color BotW|Blue|windcleaver}}? You remembered our promise! Thanks! Let me see!|Nebb|BotW}} * The sixth Weapon is an [[Ancient Battle Axe+]].{{Cite|Have you ever heard of an {{Color BotW|Blue|ancient battle axe+}}? Grandpa said you can't find those around here. If you get ahold of one, let me see it|Nebb|BotW}} Nebb will give Link another Silver Rupee for showing him one. {{Cite|Isn't that...an {{Color BotW|Blue|ancient battle axe+}}? So cool! Let me see!|Nebb|BotW}} * The seventh Weapon is the [[Frostspear]].{{Cite|Have you heard of the {{Color BotW|Blue|frostspear}}? So...when my grandpa was young, he looked for it but couldn't find it. So please! If you find it, please let me see it!|Nebb|BotW}} Bringing Nebb a Frostspear will result in him giving Link a [[Gold Rupee]].{{Cite|Isn't that the {{Color BotW|Blue|frostspear}}? So cool! Let me see!|Nebb|BotW}} * The final Weapon is an [[Ancient Short Sword]].{{Cite|So, have you heard of the {{Color BotW|Blue|ancient short sword}}? Grandpa said you can't find those around here. If you get ahold of one, let me see it!|Nebb|BotW}} For bringing Nebb the final weapon, he will give Link a [[Diamond]].{{Cite|Isn't that...the {{Color BotW|Blue|ancient short sword}}? Nice! Nice! Let me see, let me see!|Nebb|BotW}} After seeing all of the Weapons, Nebb thanks Link, and he is sure his grandpa is happy wherever he is.{{Cite|Thanks for showing me so many things! I'm sure my grandpa is super happy... wherever he is! Bye!|Nebb|BotW}} He runs off, and the [[Side Quest]] will be completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | A young man named Nebb in Hateno Village wants you to show him a particular weapon.
